text: Maryam, his shift manager, asks to pay Gwarzo Distributors for stock.
The card says who asks, what for, how much, and where.
Ikenna taps Approve to open the sheet with all the details.
First payment to this account: he checks the details with Gwarzo.
He adds a comment. It is recorded with his decision.
He taps Approve. The sheet shows Approved, then the card clears.
